lines: Their attacks repelled the Zombies one by one.
The Zombies, who were simply rampaging wildly, were no match for the two Taimanin, even if they were students.
Uwaaah! More appeared out of nowhere!
No matter how many we defeated, new Zombies kept appearing from beyond the mist.
And it was such that even the Zombies that we thought we had already defeated would jolt back up after a while and attack us again.
Really!! What's the heck!? There's no end to this!!
The number of enemies did not decrease at all. On the contrary, we were now completely surrounded by a horde of Zombies.
Yeah, it's gonna get dangerous if this continues. I want to break through them all at once, but... Hebiko?
Awww, c'mon, they stink!! So sticky and groooooss!! Don't come any closer, Hebiko's suckers are sensitive!
Aieeeeeee!! Don't look at me like that!! Your faces are too scaryyyy!!
The Zombies presumably weren't even that strong, but this bizarre situation seemed to have taken quite a toll on Hebiko and Shikanosuke's mental state.
You really aren't being helpful!! Hey!! ーBut man we're in trouble.
Even if they weren't particularly strong, defeating this many Zombies by myself would be difficult.
I have to bring those two back to their senses somehow... Hey, Hebiko!? Shikanosuke!?
M-Maybe Zombie octopuses... are a thing too! Ahaha!
Th-That's it! If I become a Zombie, I won't be scared of them anymore...! Hahaha!
This is bad, their brains are going to turn into Zombies before their bodiesーhm!?
From within the mist, several blades flashed.
The Zombies collapsed to the floor, their rotten blood spewing everywhere.
Standing beyond them like a Buddhist statue carrying golden swords on its back was a figure, no, a girlー
Even when all the Zombies turned to look at her, she silently put the back-mounted swords into action without changing her expression.
Her flashing slashes were reflected by the mist.
And the next moment, a group of Zombies were collapsed on the ground.
(A-Amazingー That many Zombies in an instant!?)
Who the hell I am? That's quite a thing to say. You don't have even a single word of gratitude for the person who saved your life?
I am Akitsu. Ryomanin Yomi Akitsu.
I'm here on Madam's orders. You are her business partners, aren't you?
(Who is this girl...? Ryomanin...? What is that...?)
